page.notes: The Greek word after "Montacutium" is printed in Greek letters and is not certain; the reading given is a best guess marked [?]. The first word of the page, "dam", is a fragment of a word begun on the previous page and is kept as printed. The line "in quatuor specimen" may be read with its line break; the italic and roman distinction in some names is judged from the scan.
